name: Brandon Gill
summary: Gill advocates sharply reduced immigration, cultural assimilation and citizenship-based access to public benefits. He supports protective tariffs, broad executive authority, gun rights and anti-abortion policies, while opposing institutional DEI and public broadcasting subsidies.
